1879059869.Skill_Desc: Heals the Champion for a percentage of their health over time.

1879097885.Skill_Desc: Seeing a ranged opponent preparing an assault, you take careful aim and disrupt their attempts.

1879134365.Skill_Desc: Mastery over the Shield: Allows Warden to perform Shield Gambits quickly.

1879157277.Skill_Desc: Call upon your Soldier to assist you in battle, who has trained as a Bannerguard.\n<rgb=#FF0000>Can only be used inside of a Skirmish, while out of combat.</rgb>

1879205789.Skill_Desc: A horse from the Springtime Festival.
1879205789.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Spring Festival for Mithril Coins. Also available from the 'Pick a Mount' package.

1879209885.Skill_Desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the warden.

1879231389.Skill_Desc: A triumphant blow, allowing the Warden to deal even more damage.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879241629.Skill_Desc: Crying for the wrath of Rohan, you unleash terrible ruin upon your foe.

1879255453.Skill_Desc: An attack that impairs the target, removing a corruption and reducing their combat readiness if you are flanking them.

1879261981.Skill_Desc: When an enemy is defeated, you let out a Cry that increases attack speed for you and your allies.

1879266845.Skill_Desc: The Dúnedain are skilled at quickly loosing arrows at their foes.

1879311261.Skill_Desc: Allows you to break free of effects that cause you to lose control of your actions.

1879326493.Skill_Desc: Summons a goat to keep you company.
1879326493.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from participating in the story of Bingo Boffin. May be bartered for in Eregion.

1879342109.Skill_Desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Haerondir.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879354909.Skill_Desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Conquest of Gorgoroth, you're able to quickly return to the Udûn Foothold. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879365405.Skill_Desc: Brings out a thrush to keep you company.

1879411741.Skill_Desc: Summons a loveable and hard-working donkey.
1879411741.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Limited time availability for Figments of Splendour and in Traveller's and Adventurer's Lootboxes.

1879416221.Skill_Desc: Summons a sheep to keep you company.
1879416221.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Crafted from a recipe available for barter from the March on Gundabad Quartermaster.

1879427869.Skill_Desc: Glúrkub's most damaging strike requires him to leave his feet, but he does so gracefully and without warning.

1879452573.Skill_Desc: Even in the midst of battle, you're able to push your body to move faster for a brief period.

1879457565.Skill_Desc: Channel your desperation into a blur of impossibly fast strikes, dealing significant damage to enemies in front of you.

1879466269.Skill_Desc:
Advance on your opponent with two thrusts.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:
 Finishers deal increased damage.</rgb>
<rgb=#ecdd11> Debilitating Strike disarms your target.</rgb>
<rgb=#33BCFF>Dramatic Flourish gives even greater chance to critically hit.</rgb>

1879467293.Skill_Desc: You never know what forgotten treasures have been left at the bottom of your pockets.\n\nRummaging in your pocket may turn up different objects.

1879467805.Skill_Desc: You call on nature to aid an ally and increase the Morale of your target.

1879488029.Skill_Desc: Summons an eagle-type companion.\n\nThis is a noble creature which can deal damage and, if called upon, will sacrifice itself to save you.
1879488029.Skill_Name: Friend of Noble Birds (Frosted Forest Owl)

1879502365.Skill_Desc: Examine an unsettling skull recovered from Utug-bûr.
1879502365.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: An unsettling relic from the depths of Utug-bûr

1879506589.Skill_Desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, send forth searing acid in a cone in front of you.<rgb=#00ffff>\n\nCan be prepared as a Sorcerous Study.</rgb>

1879508253.Skill_Desc: Double down on your current target, increasing the tier of a current damaging gamble and rolling damaging gambles on surrounding enemies.

1879508637.Skill_Desc: Summons a striped grodbog protector to accompany you on your travels.

1879510045.Skill_Desc: Interrupt an enemy's actions with a single melee strike and follow it with a single bow-attack at close range.

1879517981.Skill_Desc: Call upon the eagle's conviction to restore the Morale of your fellows.

1879522077.Skill_Desc: Place down a memento you found in Idagâl. You may want to block your ears.
1879522077.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Place down a memento you found in Idagâl. You may want to block your ears.\n\nAvailable from reputation barter after reaching Respected tier with Hamât Renewed.

1879532573.Skill_Desc: Defeating a foe has a 1% chance to reveal a hidden reward. Ends when it triggers.
